en-US.author: CAST AI Group, Inc.
en-US.description: A terminal coding agent powered by multi-model orchestration.
en-US.longDescription: Kimchi is a terminal coding agent that routes tasks to different large language models by role, such as orchestrator, builder, reviewer, and explorer, through its multi-model orchestration.
en-US.name: Kimchi
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
New Features
- feat(pii-redaction): per-category and per-entity redaction policy by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1699
Bug Fixes
- fix(side-chat): make /btw non-fullscreen notice an informative hint by @mszostok in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1713
- fix: apply curated thinking levels to custom and gateway thinking maps by @Zilv1nas in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1708
Documentation
- docs(agents): shorten TUI pointer in AGENTS.md by @mszostok in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1712
Other Changes
- fix(claude): let users turn Claude Code experimental betas back on by @mikeflame in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1686
- docs(agents): fix two stale paths in AGENTS.md by @mikeflame in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1518
- feat: show workspace setup dialog on /teleport by @patrickpichler in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1676
Full Changelog: https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/compare/v1.33.1...v1.33.2

zh-CN.description: 由多模型编排驱动的终端编码代理。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kimchi 是一款终端编码代理，通过多模型编排按角色（编排者、构建者、审查者、探索者等）将任务路由到不同的大语言模型。
